verdict.rationale: The evidence shows branch and tag rulesets (require PRs, reviews and checks, block force pushes) and personal access tokens limited to the permissions you grant. These are branch protection and token scoping, not role or permission assignment to people or teams. Nothing documents organization-, project-, repository- or environment-level permission assignment, so the rulesets and token scopes are adjacent controls only.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can assign granular permissions at organization, project, repository, branch, and environment level
